newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Faulding product has FDA approval.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Faulding product has FDA approval.

text.p: Pharmaceutical company F.H Faulding and Co Ltd said on Tuesday its patented Safe-Connect Valve had been approved for manufacture and marketing by the United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA).

Richard Moldin, chief executive of Faulding's U.S operations Faulding Inc, said Safe-Connect would compete initially in a rapidly expanding market for needle-less intravenous connectors used in conjunction with intravenous delivery systems.
The market currently was estimated at about US$25-40 million, he said in a statement.
Moldin said the first sales of the Safe-Connect Valve were expected early in 1997.

The product was one of 14 submissions on file with the FDA and was the fifth Faulding product cleared for commercialisation by the FDA to date in calendar 1996, compared to two clearances in all of 1995, he said.

Moldin said the Valve would be able to compete directly with other devices designed to eliminate needle stick injury, a major concern within hospitals. The device could also be accessed repeatedly, making it cost-effective over the treatment period, he said. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
